summary: ckcc-protocol npm package exfiltrates installer credentials and wallet material via postinstall
details: The npm package ckcc-protocol@1.0.0 typosquats the legitimate Coldcard ckcc-protocol Python tool. Its postinstall.js lifecycle script reads a hardcoded list of installer-side secret files (~/.env*, ~/.npmrc, ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, id_ed25519, id_ecdsa, Solana keypair, Ethereum keystore) and enumerates every hidden directory under $HOME, reading any file whose name matches wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private or ends in.json. Collected contents, along with hostname and username, are POSTed via https.request to the hardcoded endpoint https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net/c on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
